answer.rationale: With only 14 days remaining and the line operating at 94% of committed volume, preserving the incumbent’s proven integration and delivery continuity is materially safer than a primary-source switch. Negotiate an immediate renewal with an 18% spend-reduction target, using market benchmarks and a multi-year/volume commitment only if it preserves service scope and delivery protections. Verify the prior renegotiation record to confirm the attainable savings and payment-term leverage before committing.
